component.name: Steam Art Studio
component.summary: Manage Steam artwork with previews and restorable backups
Personaliza el arte de Steam con copias restaurables

description.p: An independent Qt application for local Steam artwork. Library, comparisons, animation previews, pending changes, downloads and backups share one workspace.
Browsing and preparing artwork do not write to Steam. Applying and restoring changes require confirmation. New community artwork requires your SteamGridDB key.
